population.selection: OBJECT_TYPE PAYLOAD, perigee below 2,000 km, e below 0.1, at least 14 element sets, the first within 2 days of the start and the last within 2 days of the end

hpop.product: analysis/epoch-state GCRF state at the latest element set, propagated by propagator/hpop resident (point mass and degree/order 20 field)
